faqs.a: Yes - this is Kowalski's specialty. We handle full structural rebuilds after fire, water, storm, or hazmat events, with scope, billing, and code compliance handled directly with your insurance carrier. You deal with one company from the first call to the final walkthrough.
faqs.q: Do you handle insurance-driven reconstruction after damage?

faqs.a: Yes. Kowalski pulls all required permits, schedules inspections, and makes sure every phase of the rebuild meets current city and county codes, including upgrades required when older work is touched. The finished work is documented for your records and your insurance file.
faqs.q: Do you pull permits and handle code compliance?

faqs.a: Most general contractors don't do restoration, and most restoration companies don't do full reconstruction. Kowalski does both - we mitigate the damage and rebuild the property as one continuous project, with one project manager and one billing relationship, so there's no handoff and no gap in responsibility if hidden damage turns up mid-job.
faqs.q: What's the difference between Kowalski and a general contractor?
